h1: Bronze Plaque Dedication for The Science Hall

schemas.name: Bronze Plaque Dedication for The Science Hall - Knowledge is the Seed of Progress
schemas.description: Design a custom bronze dedication plaque for The Science Hall with the inspiring inscription "Knowledge is the seed of progress". Professional engraving, worldwide shipping.

mainEntity.name: What size is this The Science Hall bronze plaque?

acceptedAnswer.text: This template uses a standard 600mm × 400mm (24" × 16") size, ideal for most education applications. Sizes can be customized from 300mm to 1200mm.

mainEntity.name: Can I change the inscription text?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! While this template shows "The Science Hall" and "Knowledge is the seed of progress", you can modify any text, fonts, and sizes using our interactive design tool.

mainEntity.name: How long will this bronze plaque last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bronze plaques last for generations (50-100+ years) with proper installation and our weather-resistant coating, even in outdoor environments.

mainEntity.name: How much does a bronze plaque for The Science Hall cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard 600mm × 400mm plaque typically ranges from $800-$1,500. Use our design tool for instant, accurate pricing based on your customizations.
